Installation

To install StrucGAP, use pip:

pip install strucgap

Dependencies

StrucGAP requires:

  • Python >= 3.7

  • pandas == 1.3.5

  • numpy == 1.18.1

  • matplotlib == 3.5.3

  • networkx == 2.4

  • PIL == 9.5.0

  • PyComplexHeatmap == 1.7.7

  • cairosvg == 2.7.1

  • gprofiler == 1.0.0

  • gseapy == 1.1.3

  • palettable == 3.3.3

  • plotly == 5.18.0

  • pyecharts == 2.0.6

  • re == 2.2.1

  • reportlab == 4.2.5

  • requests == 2.28.1

  • scipy == 1.7.3

  • seaborn == 0.11.1

  • sklearn == 1.0.2

  • snapshot_phantomjs == 0.0.3

  • tqdm == 4.42.1

  • umap == 0.5.6

  • upsetplot == 0.9.0

  • werkzeug == 1.0.0

  • xgboost == 1.6.2

  • ast

  • copy

  • datetime
